title: Mouse on a Raft
description: A gray mouse with large pink ears stands on a makeshift raft constructed of sticks, leaves, and a glass bottle, paddling through dark red water with a twig. The mouse wears tattered leaf armor and carries a small branch as it navigates a surreal, apocalyptic landscape of ruined towers under a blood-red sky.
prompt: A lone gray mouse wearing makeshift leaf armor stands on a raft made of sticks and a glass bottle, paddling through swirling blood-red water with a twig. Behind it are flooded ruins of ancient stone towers, some glowing with orange light, under a dramatic blood-red and purple sky with beams of light breaking through dark clouds. The water reflects the scene perfectly, creating a dark fantasy atmosphere.
